Gravitational force

 30oE is 2.00 pm. (3 mks)

5. a. Define the term Vulcanicity. (2 mks)

 ii. Two Extrusive landforms (2 mks)
6.a. i. Name three types of faults. (3 mks)
 ii. Apart from compressional force explain two other processes that may cause faulting.
 (4 mks)

 of the Great Rift Valley. (8 mks)
 c. Explain five ways in which faulting is of significance to human activities. (10 mks)
7 a. The table below shows Rainfall and Temperature figures of a station in North America.
On the graph paper provided, draw a bar graph to represent the rainfall figures. (Use a vertical scale of 1cm represent 10 mm) (5 mks)

 ii. State five characteristics of the climate experienced in the station. (5 mks)
